verdict.rationale: xAI documents first-party custom function calling with the core agent-loop round trip: the model requests a call, you execute it locally, and you return the result. The grok-4.7 spec card flags function calling as supported, and the REST API is OpenAI-compatible. However, the pack never shows typed or JSON-schema tool parameter definitions, parallel tool calls, or how multi-step chaining behaves, so the extent of the capability is unproven. missing for 10: explicit typed/JSON-schema tool definition docs, documented parallel tool calls, documented multi-step tool-call chaining behavior, independent hands-on corroboration of tool-calling fidelity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on faithful function/tool calling — typed tool definitions, parallel and multi-step calls — documented well enough to run an agent loop on this model

citations.quote: Define custom tools that the model can invoke during a conversation. The model requests the call, you execute it locally, and return the result.
The xAI API supports **tool calling**, enabling Grok to perform actions beyond generating text—like searching the web, executing code, querying your data, or calling your own custom functions.
